question: Which of the following regions is included in the list of vulnerable landscapes under the Revised Green India Mission (GIM) Plan released in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravalli Mountain Range**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Revised Green India Mission (GIM) Plan 2025** identifies vulnerable landscapes across India for ecological restoration and improved environmental sustainability.
 
• The **Aravalli Mountain Range** is one of the vulnerable landscapes identified under this plan due to extensive degradation caused by mining, deforestation, and urbanization.
 
• The Aravalli Range is crucial for **preventing desertification** in the adjoining regions of Rajasthan and maintaining ecological balance.
 
• Efforts under GIM aim to restore **native vegetation**, improve groundwater recharge, and enhance biodiversity in the Aravalli region.
 
• The inclusion of the Aravalli Mountain Range in the GIM highlights its importance in combating climate change and achieving sustainable development goals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Aravalli Mountain Range:**

 
 
• The Aravalli Range is one of the oldest mountain ranges in the world, dating back to the **Proterozoic Era**.
 
• It extends for about **800 km** across the Indian states of Rajasthan, Haryana, Gujarat, and Delhi.
 
• The range acts as a natural barrier, preventing the expansion of the **Thar Desert** into fertile regions.
 
• It is home to rich biodiversity, including native plant species and wildlife such as leopards, striped hyenas, and golden jackals.
 
• The region faces ecological challenges like illegal mining, deforestation, and loss of vegetation cover.
 
 
 
• **Green India Mission (GIM):**
 
 
• Launched under the **National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC)**, GIM aims to increase forest and tree cover for ecosystem restoration.
 
• The mission focuses on enhancing ecosystem services like **carbon sequestration, biodiversity conservation, and groundwater recharge**.
 
• It prioritizes landscapes that are vulnerable to climate change, including forests, wetlands, and urban ecosystems.
 
• GIM works in coordination with state governments, local communities, and other stakeholders for effective implementation.
 
• The Revised Plan 2025 expands the scope of the mission to include more regions and a broader range of activities.
 
 
 
• **Other Vulnerable Landscapes:**
 
 
• **Deccan Plateau:** Known for its unique geological features, the plateau faces issues like soil erosion and water scarcity.
 
• **Thar Desert:** Vulnerable to desertification and loss of biodiversity, this region requires sustainable management practices.
 
• **Indo-Gangetic Plain:** A critical agricultural zone facing threats from soil degradation, pollution, and overexploitation of water resources.
 
• Each of these landscapes has unique ecological challenges that are addressed under the Green India Mission.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Aravalli Restoration:**

 
 
• The restoration of the Aravalli Mountain Range is vital for **mitigating climate change** impacts and ensuring ecological stability.
 
• Efforts include **afforestation, soil conservation, and water resource management** to reverse degradation.
 
• Protecting the Aravalli Range contributes to preserving the **livelihoods of local communities** dependent on its resources.
 
• It also plays a key role in achieving India's commitments under the **Paris Agreement** and other international environmental frameworks.
